tasks.title: Create branch and baseline snapshot
actions: Run git status and record dirty files.
Create branch feat/wed3s-3d-booking-orchestrated.
Record Node/package manager/tool availability.
Capture current file tree, commit SHA, routes, deploy config and asset existence.
acceptance: Active branch and commit are recorded in STATE.json.

tasks.title: Behavior and route regression baseline
actions: Document booking, login, admin, POS, QR, invoice and data flows.
Create smoke tests around ?page=order and admin route without changing output.
Record current network requests and 404 assets.
acceptance: Broken current behavior is marked baseline-known, not silently fixed.
Evidence includes screenshots/traces or exact commands.
verify: Run Playwright smoke or documented manual baseline

tasks.title: Security, RLS and secret audit
actions: Inspect Supabase schemas/policies with read-only queries.
Scan HEAD and git history for secrets.
List Cloudflare env variable names without values.
Create threat model and prioritized findings.
acceptance: No secret value is written to report.
RLS evidence exists for orders/costs and admin authorization.
Any historically exposed token is marked for rotation.

tasks.title: Asset and performance inventory
actions: Inventory images, sizes, duplicate/deleted references and licenses.
Measure initial bundle/network/Lighthouse.
Record device/browser test matrix.
acceptance: Current performance baseline is stored without comparing against guessed values.

tasks.title: Extract typed service catalog
actions: Create stable service IDs and one catalog.
Replace duplicate maps through compatibility adapters.
Add tests proving current labels/prices/status behavior.
acceptance: Existing booking/POS labels and totals remain compatible.
verify: Unit tests for every service and total

tasks.title: Order schema and compatibility adapter
actions: Define Zod request/domain schemas.
Add string-to-items and items-to-legacy-string adapters.
Define status constants without changing persisted values.
acceptance: Legacy service strings round-trip for supported values.

tasks.title: Create secure order API
actions: Implement POST /api/orders.
Validate content type/body/schema/Turnstile.
Compute pricing and status server-side.
Insert idempotently and return minimal response.
acceptance: Duplicate retry does not create duplicate order.

tasks.title: Harden Telegram notification
actions: Move notification behind trusted order creation.
Escape Telegram HTML and limit fields.
Check Telegram response and apply timeout.
Separate notification failure from order transaction.
acceptance: Order still succeeds with notification failure and failure is observable.

tasks.title: Cut public booking over to API
actions: Replace direct public Supabase insert with API call.
Add idempotency UI and clear error states.
Run shadow/canary on preview.
acceptance: Public route creates valid order through API.

tasks.title: RLS lockdown after cutover
actions: Apply reviewed migration in preview.
Revoke anonymous direct order writes.
Verify admin authorization and negative cases.
Prepare production migration and rollback/forward fix.

tasks.title: Scaffold React/Vite/TypeScript shell
actions: Create workspace/app shell and pinned lockfile.
Preserve Cloudflare build/deploy constraints.
Add route adapter for ?page=order and admin.
acceptance: Booking shell does not load admin chart/xlsx chunk.

tasks.title: Design system and accessible booking shell
actions: Implement tokens, typography, layout, CTA and booking wizard without WebGL.
Add reduced motion and keyboard/focus behavior.
Use real catalog/API.
acceptance: Complete booking works with WebGL disabled.

tasks.title: Acquire and license production shoe asset
actions: Use owner-provided or clearly licensed model.
Record source/license/attribution.
Create dirty mask, clean materials and LOD plan.

tasks.title: Optimize GLB and textures
actions: Run glTF Transform inspect/dedupe/prune/texture compression.
Generate low/medium/high variants and poster.
Record triangles/draw calls/transfer sizes.
acceptance: Assets meet budget or exception has evidence.

tasks.title: Implement adaptive 3D scene
actions: Lazy-load canvas after poster.
Implement quality tiers, pause/offscreen and context recovery.
Implement dirty-to-clean shader/timeline.

tasks.title: Connect story, services and booking
actions: Link camera/material progress to narrative.
Focus service cards without blocking input.
Stop heavy motion while form active.

tasks.title: Migrate admin modules incrementally
actions: Migrate one module per PR behind compatibility adapter.
Preserve POS/receipt/QR/report behavior.
Add authorization to write paths.
acceptance: Each migrated module has regression tests.
Old module remains rollbackable until stable.

tasks.title: Full quality and security gate
actions: Run unit/contract/E2E/a11y/performance/security/mobile matrix.
Fix blocking defects only.
Create release evidence.
acceptance: All release gates pass or approved exceptions documented.

tasks.title: Preview, canary and production cutover
actions: Deploy preview.
Run smoke and canary.
Rehearse rollback.
Deploy production and verify monitoring.

tasks.title: Handover and closeout
actions: Write runbook, architecture, env variable names, known limitations and backlog.
Reconcile task/evidence/decision records.
Tag release.
acceptance: A new engineer can resume from docs without reading chat history.
No secret is present in handover.
